result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a cutoff card at the bottom of the feed, and a few minor layout/content inconsistencies.

issues.description: The last restaurant in 'Fastest near you' is clipped so the name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' and the card is cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding or a peek/carousel fade so names and cards are fully visible, or wrap/ellipsize names without cutting mid-word.

issues.description: The bottom popular restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and delivery info are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right ('Healthy' is only partly visible) with no clear indication of more categories.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and a fade or chevron so users can see the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: Promo copy is inconsistent: banner says 'min. order €10' while nearby cards show €0 / €0.90 / €2.40 delivery, which can look contradictory.
issues.suggestion: Clarify whether €10 is a minimum order vs. delivery fee, or align the banner with the listed delivery prices.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icons sit on dark food photos without a strong contrast treatment, so they may be hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Add a light circular backdrop or stronger outline so the icons remain visible on any image.
